title: Peace Lily Plant
summary: Elegant peace lily in a ceramic-style pot — a calm, low-maintenance living gift for home or office.
descriptionHtml:
The peace lily (Spathiphyllum) is a graceful indoor plant with glossy deep-green leaves and slender white spathes that appear through much of the year. Its quiet, sculptural form makes it a considerate choice for sympathy, get-well wishes, or a lasting corporate gift that keeps giving long after fresh flowers fade.

Each plant is selected for healthy, upright growth and finished for gifting. A dependable living gift for those who prefer a plant to a bouquet.

  • Light: Bright, indirect light; tolerates lower light with fewer blooms.
  • Water: Keep soil lightly moist; leaves droop as a helpful reminder to water.
  • Care level: Easy — ideal for beginners.
  • Note: Foliage can irritate pets and children if chewed.
seoTitle: Peace Lily Plant | The New Greenhouse
seoDescription: Buy a peace lily plant in Kingston, Jamaica. An easy-care living gift for sympathy, get-well, and corporate flowers Jamaica.
careInstructions: Place in bright, indirect light and keep the soil lightly moist, watering when the top inch feels dry. Drooping leaves mean it is thirsty and recover quickly after watering.

availabilityNote: Plant size and pot finish are subject to seasonal availability.

title: Snake Plant (Sansevieria)
summary: Architectural snake plant with upright, patterned leaves — nearly indestructible and perfect for desks and lobbies.
descriptionHtml:
The snake plant (Sansevieria, now Dracaena trifasciata) is prized for its bold, upright leaves banded in green and edged in soft gold. Structural and forgiving, it thrives on neglect, making it a smart, long-lasting gift for busy people, new offices, and homes with less-than-perfect light.

A clean, modern living gift that suits corporate desks, reception areas, and everyday styling alike.

  • Light: Tolerates low light; happiest in bright, indirect light.
  • Water: Water sparingly — allow soil to dry fully between waterings.
  • Care level: Easy — very drought tolerant.
  • Note: Mildly toxic if ingested by pets.
seoTitle: Snake Plant Sansevieria | The New Greenhouse
seoDescription: Order a low-maintenance snake plant in Kingston, Jamaica. Hardy corporate flowers Jamaica alternative for desks, offices, and everyday gifting.
careInstructions: Give bright, indirect light where possible, though it tolerates low light. Water sparingly and let the soil dry out completely between waterings to avoid root rot.
deliveryNote: Same-day delivery may be available across Kingston & St. Andrew for orders placed before 2PM.
availabilityNote: Plant height and pot finish are subject to seasonal availability.

title: Phalaenopsis Orchid Plant
summary: A refined white phalaenopsis orchid in bloom — a long-lasting, upscale living gift for any celebration.
descriptionHtml:
The phalaenopsis, or moth orchid, is one of the most elegant living gifts available. Arching stems carry rows of pristine white blooms above broad green leaves, with a single display often lasting several weeks to a few months. It is a considered choice for congratulations, corporate gifting, or simply bringing quiet luxury into a room.

Choose our standard presentation or a premium wrap for a more finished, gift-ready arrival.

  • Light: Bright, indirect light; avoid harsh direct sun.
  • Water: Water roughly once a week; never leave roots sitting in water.
  • Care level: Moderate — rewards a light, consistent touch.
  • Bloom: Pure white spathes on graceful arching stems.
seoTitle: Phalaenopsis Orchid Plant | The New Greenhouse
seoDescription: White phalaenopsis orchid plant in Kingston, Jamaica. A long-lasting living gift for congratulations, corporate flowers Jamaica, and everyday luxury.
careInstructions: Keep in bright, indirect light away from direct sun and drafts. Water about once a week, letting excess drain fully so the roots never sit in standing water.
deliveryNote: Same-day delivery may be available across Kingston & St. Andrew for orders placed before 2PM.
availabilityNote: Bloom count and stem number vary by plant and are subject to seasonal availability.
